projectMetadata.description: A comprehensive web suite for independent USANA distributors. Features a cinematic, gamified public-facing suite (System A) and private, offline-first business tools (System B).

architecture.frontend: React, Vite, Framer Motion (System A), Mantine UI (System B)

phases.name: Phase 2 — Core features (System A - Cinematic Web Suite)

items.label: CinematicSection & Framer Motion Engine
items.instructions: Build the custom Framer Motion scroll container and interactive morphing components to replace legacy Vanilla JS scroll-engine.

items.label: Rich Media / YouTube Integration
items.instructions: Implement a seamless, custom video player overlay for YouTube assets within the CinematicSection.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Core features (System B - React Overhaul)

items.label: Terminology & Disclaimers Pass
items.instructions: Replace 'Clinical Dose' with 'Recommended Dosage'. De-medicalize 'Protocol', 'Interventions', etc. Ensure 'Not Medical Advice' is cleanly presented.

items.label: Progressive Disclosure (YAZIO-style screens)
items.instructions: Implement full-screen views per question (Age, Sex, Focus) with large typography, smooth transitions, and dynamic progress bar.

items.label: Dynamic Branching Logic
items.instructions: Ensure flow skips irrelevant questions based on selected primary focus and maps precisely to guidanceData.conditions.

items.label: 50/50 Split Product Discovery
items.instructions: Render prominent product imagery restricted to <= 50% viewport, utilizing swipeable cards or expanding drawers for detail.

items.label: Summary Screen & CSV/PDF Export
items.instructions: Final summary step containing clean accordions/cards, and fully wired CSV import/export functions linked to the wizardState.

items.label: Portrait/Landscape Composition Pass
items.instructions: Test all views on mobile (portrait) and desktop (landscape).

items.label: Accessibility (a11y) Pass
items.instructions: Ensure keyboard navigation works in System B. Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'.

items.label: Initial GitHub Pages Deployment
items.instructions: Confirm .github/workflows/deploy.yml has completed at least one successful run.

openDecisions.text: Brand assets / final palette not yet confirmed.
USANA distributor policy review for PUBLIC content.
Which React UI ecosystem/library to adopt.
openDecisions.resolution: Split architecture adopted: Mantine UI used for data-heavy administrative System B. Custom React + Framer Motion used for cinematic, gamified System A.
